claycode.finding: G9 V3 semantics are richer than the published EBNF: comparisons and if-blocks used by the current candidate are not represented by grammar.ebnf.

frank.finding: Current FRANK feedback asks ClayCode to compile a typed LoopDynamicsReadout/controller/intervention contract; loop-of-loops remains OPEN, not truth.

clayresearch.finding: Moving stack pins G9 V3 and mandates implementation over semantic change absent an executable counterexample.

claygraph.finding: Typed hyperrelations, epoch-bound projection and distinct selection/provenance receipts can carry loop topology/readout references without granting truth or effect authority.

unifieddb.finding: Revisioned work/effect receipts and semantic state can persist loop-readout identities; no physical monolith requirement follows.

gwt.finding: Loop dynamics must remain separate from selection/broadcast/use/outcome/re-entry and from emergence claims.

hyperposition.finding: Alternatives, higher-order relations, gain/delay/timescale and intervention semantics already map onto generic ClayCode records/relations; no new syntax was required in the tested loop contract.

emergenz.finding: Recurrence is not emergence; loop readouts are instrumentation inputs for lesion/rescue/counterfactual tests, not an emergence scalar.

harness.finding: H2 Clay Harness remains blocked on ClayCode BASE; a grammar/parser conformance gate directly reduces the blocker for H-WP-03 and later H2 differential work.

promotion_note: Cross-branch agreement was treated as shared ancestry unless independently tested.
